note: Extracted verbatim from the hardcoded LINES tuple in app/tools/tts/generate_audio.py on 2026-08-01, so the café's casting lives with the story instead of inside the generator. Nothing about the takes changed: staff and learner lines pin `Ono_Anna` explicitly, which is the same voice they previously inherited from the tool's --voice default, and the nine seeds are the ones already pinned in code. The learner's on-demand model clips are voiced by the café staff on purpose — the in-scene teacher models the line, and the café learner is uncast, unlike the taproom's `sohee`. Narration is `aiden`, the same storyteller as the taproom, so the narrator stays one person across the app and stays distinct from the café staff. Lines without a seed derive one from the line id rather than array position, so they may be reordered or inserted freely. Clips ship to app/public/audio/qwen3/.
